name: ai-outfit-miniprogram
install:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cursor/skills"
rm -rf /tmp/mission-command-cloud-skill
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/mingge123-s/mission-command-cloud.git /tmp/mission-command-cloud-skill
rm -rf "$HOME/.cursor/skills/mission-command-cloud"
cp -a /tmp/mission-command-cloud-skill/.cursor/skills/mission-command-cloud "$HOME/.cursor/skills/"
cd server
npm install
